explication: OpenBot is a local-first workspace for creating persistent AI teammates, chatting with them, and managing their workspaces. The main workflow runs from desktop or mobile interaction through the desktop IPC boundary to agent services and provider runtimes; optional account and remote-server services extend it across devices. The graph also shows the documented marketplace, channels, queues, browser, and file-management capabilities. Storage edges are grounded in the excerpts; broader product links use README statements and SOURCE INDEX references, so unsampled internals are represented at subsystem level.
